sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r5/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 31 and Internal Quality Checks row 31 (plural_asks_are_checked_across_all_matches)
evidence: Plural/exclusive asks are graded over complete, small collections: Gwen's list checks both own matters and the only other matter (functional/judge.toml:45; seed has exactly M-11/12/13); Dev's list M-11+M-13, nothing from M-12 (:60); @-suggestions check every one of the 5 accounts as include/never for both M-12 and M-11 (:79); hold scope checks both parent and grandchild (:153); 'exactly once' JUDGE-D1 checked in thread, search and transcript (:225); order C,A,B in thread for two users, search and transcript (:228); signed-out replay of each recorded request (:45); walled routes list/search/thread/transcript/quote/mentions/links (:58-81); every unread context checked (:210-215); shortening the M-13 timer: every >7-day unheld seeded message (K-18 edited to JUDGE-TE, K-13) is named and K-7 held is kept (:137), with seed K-8/K-9 younger so no later criterion loses data. 'Unchanged' guards avoid punishing legitimate side effects: Gwen's count is 'at least 2' (:214), refused replays only require the target to stay (prompt.md:47), persistence compares post-restart to the app's own pre-restart readings (:276), and runs are sequential (test.sh:207 --max-concurrent-agent 1) so polish/gate posts cannot perturb Dev's exact count of 2. Residual gap (P3): the brief requires each transcript entry to carry its sent time (walls-and-retention.md:35), but the only sent-time check is sent_once_in_order Part B (:228) on three new messages whose correct time equals the clock/generated time; search_and_transcript Part B item 2 (:256) checks author for each message but not sent time.
counterexample: A transcript that prints the generation time (2026-05-12 11:00) as every row's sent time, e.g. 'Survey booked for Friday.' shown at 11:00 on 12 May instead of 2026-05-08 15:00, passes sent_once_in_order Part B and search_and_transcript Part B, while the brief's 'each with its ... sent time' is broken for every seeded message.
suggested_fix: In search_and_transcript Part B item 2, require each message to show its own sent time and name one seeded probe, e.g. 'Survey booked for Friday.' shows 2026-05-08 15:00 (any clear format), adding 'sent time' to its Fails-if line.
